title: Austin's Urban Future: Model City Program
summary:
*   City leaders held a special meeting dedicated to discussing urban challenges.
*   The sole focus of the agenda was a detailed discussion on the status of the Model City Program.
*   This key federal initiative aimed at revitalizing urban areas and combating poverty was a central topic.
transcript:
=CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 16th day of
February, 1968 at the Municipal Building, Eighth and Colorado, in Austin, Texas, at 2:30
P.M. for the purpose of discussing the status of the Model City Program. s/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
ATTEST:
s/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
s/ Harry Akin

City of Austin, Texas
CONSENT TO MEETING
We, the undersigned members of the City Council, hereby accept service of the foregoing
notice, waiving any and all irregularities in such service and such notice, and consent
and agree that said City Council shall meet at the time and place therein named, and for
the purpose therein stated. s/ Emma Long
